text:
Ava: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  using this thread for concise Qs about release rituals, oncall swaps, quality bars, and SLA semantics. I'll route to owners. Please keep replies short.
Diego: Question: what's the planned change to release freeze windows? We keep hitting friction for small patches.
Ava: Proposal on the table: shorten patch freeze from 48h -> 24h, keep major release freeze at 72h. Want to hear SRE impact.
Liam: SRE note: 24h for patch-only is acceptable if we gate with automated canary and CI. Need a canary acceptance rule: canary_error_rate < 1% AND 99p latency regression <5%. We'll add an alert and dashboard widget.
Priya: For Dedicated customers, do we need scheduled notice for patches that may affect latency? Legal/PM input needed.
Maya: On quality bars: can we publish a "ship checklist" (critical-path unit tests, integration smoke, changelog, perf guardrails) rather than a blanket coverage target?
Ava: Yes. I want a short checklist that focuses on risk reduction not arbitrary coverage numbers. I'll draft and drop into #eng-process.
Nora: Oncall swaps: current policy requires 2-week notice to swap. Can we allow one-off swaps with your buddy for last-minute conflicts?
Liam: Operationally yes if rotation lead approves and PagerDuty schedule is updated. Must ensure handoff overlap isn't reduced. Do the PD change + calendar invite.
Diego: SLA clarity: For hosted API 99.9% SLA, what counts as a failure? Retries? Client-side timeouts?
Ava: SLA counts server-side failures (5xx and gateway errors we return). Retries don't change the SLA number; we measure requests accepted by our gateway and successful responses. We'll add examples to the SLA doc.
SamBot: deploy-bot: "Canary policy: default 30% for 15m, auto-promote on green metrics. See /deploy canary-policy for configs."
Maya: Practical ask: require a changelog entry for hotfixes even if one-liner  it helps support.
Diego: +1 :thumbsup: Also can we get a one-pager post-deploy checklist (CPU, mem, 99p latency, error rate checks)?
Priya: I'll publish a maintenance-notice template and a post-deploy checklist in #eng-process by EOD Friday and link back here.
Liam: CLI snippet from SRE runbook to check canary error rate:
```
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/query -d 'metric=canary_error_rate&window=15m' | jq '.value < 0.01'
```
Maya: Add a reminder in the checklist to run perf smoke for top-3 customer flows.
Ava: Thanks all. If you can paste small snippets (example changelog lines, PD change text, canary config) here, we'll fold them into the published document. I'll summarize and close this thread next week. :white_check_mark:
